name: email_inbox
description: Check Jarvis's opt-in Gmail command inbox using the approved senders in config/contacts.json. Examples: 'check Jarvis email requests', 'show email inbox command status', 'preview requests without replying'. status reports durable processing state; preview reads/authenticates candidates without executing or sending; poll executes admitted requests and sends sender-only threaded replies. Named attachments are verified and saved to Stash before the approved request runs; downstream actions require the configured tool allowlist. Configuration cannot be changed through this tool. Use Google Workspace Gmail tools for ordinary mailbox reads or outgoing messages.

availability.setup_hint: Enable Google Workspace and its Gmail search, message-read and send tools, then configure the opt-in jarvis_email section in config/contacts.json.
